##### Project general facts

Celia Homes is a residential tower by Abou Eid that combines contemporary design with efficient layouts and a strong focus on everyday comfort. The project offers studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments with large windows that bring natural light into the living spaces, creating bright and practical homes for professionals, couples and small families.

The amenity offer is designed for relaxation, wellness and social life. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool and a jacuzzi, a kids' play area with its own pool, and both indoor and outdoor gyms. Leisure spaces include an outdoor cinema, an arcade room, an entertainment lounge, a barbecue area and landscaped seating areas, while a business centre provides a professional setting within the building.

Apartments are delivered fully furnished, with premium materials, high-quality finishes and modern fixtures that create a ready-to-live home from day one.

##### Location descript    ion and benefits

Dubai Residence Complex is a residential community within Dubailand, offering a calm neighbourhood setting with everyday conveniences close at hand. The area combines apartment living with nearby schools, healthcare facilities, retail and parks, making it a practical choice for families and professionals.

Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club, Dubai Outlet Mall, IMG Worlds of Adventure and Silicon Central Mall are all within a short drive. Downtown Dubai is also within easy reach, while the main road network provides access to Business Bay, Dubai Marina and Dubai International Airport.

Freehold ownership is available to international buyers. The combination of accessible apartment living, nearby leisure attractions and convenient road connections positions the area for both end users and investors seeking well-located homes in Dubailand.
